description: moyai 舫い — a receipt for DRAWING inference from the commons, recording whether it was free (subsistence floor / idle mesh) or BURNED reciprocity credit (discretionary surplus under contention) per ADR-2606062100. This is the spend side of give-to-get. The firewall is explicit on every receipt: `withinSubsistenceFloor` draws are ALWAYS free and ALWAYS served (information-as-Basic-High-Income, delivered by need not by contribution); `creditBurned` is non-zero ONLY for discretionary surplus above the floor while the mesh is congested. A member with zero credit is never denied essential information — only non-essential surplus waits behind contributors. No monetary field exists: drawing inference costs credit-or-nothing, never money (cash≡0).

drawerDid.description: DID of the member/agent drawing inference. No-server-key: the draw is authorized by the member's signature (ADR-2605231525).

requestedUnits.description: Reference inference units requested in this draw.

decision.description: How the draw was served (fair_share.py). 'free-subsistence' = within the unconditional floor (information-as-BHI); 'free-idle' = surplus served free because the mesh had spare capacity; 'charge-surplus' = discretionary surplus under contention, credit burned; 'deferred' = surplus wanted under contention with no credit, essential floor still served, surplus waits behind contributors.

creditBurned.description: moyai credit units burned for this draw. Non-zero ONLY when decision='charge-surplus' (discretionary surplus above the floor under contention). 0 for every free/deferred draw. A burn can never exceed live balance (no overdraw).

withinSubsistenceFloor.description: True if (the floor portion of) this draw fell within the member's unconditional subsistence allowance — information-as-Basic-High-Income, never gated by credit.

essentialGuaranteed.description: INVARIANT, always true. Essential information access is guaranteed on every draw regardless of credit: the subsistence floor is served first, unconditionally. moyai only ever defers non-essential surplus. This is the on-chain proof that the reward does NOT affect Basic High Income.

meshLoadPermille.description: Mesh load at draw time, per-mille. Credit is charged only at/above the contention threshold; below it surplus is free for all (moyai is a congestion fair-share scheduler, not a paywall).

redeemableUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT, always 0. Drawing inference costs credit or nothing — never money. cash≡0 (N1).

jobRef.description: Optional AT URI of the inference job this draw served.
